scope: One original authored PPJ, one native PPTX build, one exact embedded-program recovery, one LibreOffice/Poppler render, and one page-by-page human visual review.

pages.note: Claim boundary, title hierarchy, measured profile, source, and folio remain readable without card-wall composition.
IF, THEN, BECAUSE rows and preset rejection rule read in the intended order with no clipping.
Method tree has explicit editable YES and NO labels; connectors do not obscure labels or node text.
Native experiment table, read-through, and source boundary remain legible at dense report scale.
Baseline, intervention, and follow-up durations are encoded by width and discontinuity marks without collision.
Native columns show concise value-only labels; the read-through column and chart marks remain separated.
Native workload line and endpoint evidence stay clear; labels do not cover the series.
Estimate, confidence interval, conservative bound, and zero marker remain distinct and interpretable.
Five gates, rollout action, and stop rule form one readable decision sequence.
Dark decision-record handoff preserves action, interpretability rules, source boundary, and folio.

limitations: All values are synthetic and illustrative; this is not operational evidence.
Rendering was checked with LibreOffice and Poppler on macOS, not Windows PowerPoint.
Playback evidence is structural; Keynote and PowerPoint playback were not claimed.
The runtime review had no host visual-review provider, so the page-by-page human review is recorded separately here.
